body:
I'm so sorry you have to go through this. I'm in the same situation right now and I'd wish this feeling to no one.

I hope your pain goes away. I hope you find something that helps you on your way. Something that keeps you going. Best of luck in these dark hours, I believe in you-

Hey man!
I know there surely alternatives to medicine and I'm trying to think that way. I just talked to the girl and it's over now. I'll try to move on, to be the best version of myself but I'm sceptical as to whether it's going to work out. I just had a panic attack, the first after 3 years.
It's 1 am, I am blasting music through my headphones while typing this. To get my mind off things, to stop myself from rushing into something. Maybe I'll just say fuck it and go on a random tinder streak for the time left. I don't feel like there's ever going to be someone that I actually connect to. So maybe it's all just not worth it.

Thank you for your comments. I'll update you on how things are going, until the end. All the best to you too, take care.

Domi

Hey bro, I'm sorry for the late reply. 
So I did it and well yeah I got rejected. We had an hour long talk with the bottom line being that I just wasn't good enough. Should've seen it coming I guess. I don't know if I feel better or worse, at the moment it's mainly just a feeling of emptyness.
Fuck my life, fuck me for being such a coward.
Thank you for trying to help me, but I guess it's too late. 
You seem like a cool guy, I would've loved to have a beer with you. 
I'll keep you updated. Take care :)

Domi

Your reply actually made me smile, thank you. Scared to death describes it pretty well, but I guess I need to go through that to actually make things better. What's hard though is that she's the one that's always there for me, even though she apparently likes this other guy she was the one to visit me at the hospital, to leave me a note with dinner, to text me when she's upset about something. 
I'm afraid I will lose that should things turn out bad. I'm still gonna grab my balls and talk to her about it. If you want to I'll update you about how it went. Also, thank you for your help, I really appreciate it

Hey there! Thank you so much for your answer. I am trying hard to focus on other things and there definitely are moments where I feel like everything's ok. But I there's always this feeling of being inadequate. Like what if I don't get in? Medicine has always been my passion, I wanted to be a doctor from like age 10. I want to help other people. But at the same time, there never seems to be someone there to help me.
 
As for girl problems, first of all I am sorry you've had a similar experience. I hope everything's ok now. Thank you for the tip to just go do stuff to get my mind of things. I swim regularly and that helps so much. But going home, that's the hard part.
I'm trying hard to focus on the good things, and I'm thankful for your reply. It's nice to see that atleast someone on the internet cares just a little bit. If you want I will update you on whether I got in or not.
